snippets.snippet_text: "You can connect your Stripe account to receive payments for credit card sales directly to your Stripe account. This feature is available in all countries where Stripe operates, except Brazil, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, Mexico, Philippines, and Thailand."

"If bank payouts aren't supported in your country, we will pay you via PayPal. You just need an individual or business PayPal account without any restrictions. All PayPal payouts are processed in USD and usually arrive within 1–3 business days. PayPal payouts have a 2% processing fee."

"We do not support alternative payout modes like Payoneer, Wise, check, money order, wire transfer, etc. If your country is not supported by direct bank deposits or PayPal, then unfortunately, we have no way to pay you out for now."

"Also, if you are selling as a business, the business must be registered in the same country. Having a bank account based in another country will not, unfortunately, allow us to pay you out to that bank account unless you physically live (and can prove residence) in that country."
